content:
nora: quick idea - introduce dim-buckets for fastpath quotas (tiny/med/large). avoids small-dim clients monopolizing fast lanes.
ben: agree. propose buckets tiny<=128, med<=512, large>512. console shows per-bucket allowance + usage heatmap.
raj: enforcement: router checks tenant.bucket_quota before honoring X-Embed-Latency-Hint-ms. if exhausted, fallback to normal batching.
ben: telemetry: emit event tags: bucket, latency_hint_ms, route_variant, batch_size, effective_units. store per-tenant histograms. sample full payloads 0.2%.
observability-bot: metric.alert -> fastpath_share_high tenant=widgetco bucket=tiny value=46% window=10m
nora: UX: add "preview fastpath" mode in console to replay last 7 days and surface estimated cost delta. plus an apply-for-trial flow.
raj: rollout: internal tenants only for 48h, region eu-west first, add console kill-switch.
ben: billing change: add fastpath_adjustment column to invoice lines and annotate usage in console.
nora: I'll draft RFC with example curl/snippet and a short playbook for oncall.
